title: Daemon attach uses persisted action history
notes: Reuses the approval.approved-patch replay bundle to protect the persisted event history that attach and reconnect flows read after daemon ownership changes. Replay does not prove live daemon process health, socket availability, or stale-owner recovery.

baseline_history.rationale: Promoted for GBX-722 as the replay-representable daemon attach contract: durable canonical events remain available after live ownership changes, while process lifecycle behavior stays integration-only.

Refreshed for GBX-1040 after adding durable ToolAttemptHeartbeat telemetry; the shared approval baseline now records canonicalized tool-attempt long-run evidence without depending on generated runtime UUIDs.
